about.title: The Xero Degrees Story: More Than Just Food
about.paragraph1: Born from a passion for bringing people together over innovative and mouth-watering comfort food, Xero Degrees has rapidly become a Delhi sensation. We envisioned a vibrant, friendly space where every visit feels like a celebration, a place to escape the ordinary and dive into extraordinary flavors.
about.paragraph2: At Xero Degrees, we're famous for our unique spins on everyday favorites – from loaded fries that redefine indulgence, to sky-high Freak Shakes that are as much a treat for the eyes as they are for the taste buds. Our menu is a curated journey of fun, flavor, and freshness, all served in an atmosphere designed for unforgettable moments with friends and family.
